(rule!
 ;; A C-shaped frame of one color has an OPEN mouth on one side.
 ;; Yellow(4) pours in: rows level with the mouth interior flood with 4
 ;; from the outside wall through the cavity, the two arm-tip rows get
 ;; a 4 just outside the mouth plus a cavity fill, and beyond the tips
 ;; the 4s run away as 45-degree diagonal spouts. Normalize so the
 ;; mouth faces LEFT (flip/transpose), pour once, map back.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define sc  ;; the frame's color: first non-0 non-4 value
       (find-first (lambda (v) (and (> v 0) (not (= v 4))))
                   (remove-duplicates (apply append g))))
     (define (tips-of pos)  ;; mouth tips: run ends flanking the gap
       (let* ((sp (sort pos <))
              (gaps (filter (lambda (i) (> (- (nth sp (+ i 1)) (nth sp i)) 1))
                            (range 0 (- (length sp) 1)))))
         (list (if (empty? gaps) (first sp) (nth sp (last gaps)))
               (if (empty? gaps) (last sp) (nth sp (+ (first gaps) 1))))))
     (define (pour grid)  ;; mouth faces LEFT
       (let* ((hh (rows grid)) (ww (cols grid))
              (cells (find-color grid sc))
              (r1 (min-of first cells)) (r2 (max-of first cells))
              (c1 (min-of second cells)) (c2 (max-of second cells))
              (tips (tips-of (filter (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c1) sc))
                                     (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))
              (tt (first tips)) (bt (second tips))
              (mouth-c (- c1 1))
              (flood (lambda (out r cs)
                       (for/fold ((a out)) ((c cs))
                         (if (zero? (at grid r c)) (set-cell a r c 4) a)))))
         (for/fold ((out grid)) ((r (range 0 hh)))
           (cond ((< r tt)
                  (let ((yc (- mouth-c (- tt r))))
                    (if (and (>= yc 0) (< yc ww) (zero? (at grid r yc)))
                        (set-cell out r yc 4)
                        out)))
                 ((> r bt)
                  (let ((yc (- mouth-c (- r bt))))
                    (if (and (>= yc 0) (< yc ww) (zero? (at grid r yc)))
                        (set-cell out r yc 4)
                        out)))
                 ((or (= r tt) (= r bt))
                  (flood (set-cell out r mouth-c 4)
                         r (range (+ c1 1) (+ c2 1))))
                 (else (flood out r (range 0 (+ c2 1))))))))
     (let* ((cells (find-color g sc))
            (r1 (min-of first cells)) (r2 (max-of first cells))
            (c1 (min-of second cells)) (c2 (max-of second cells))
            (full (lambda (fixed by-row?)
                    (all? (lambda (k) (= (at g (if by-row? fixed k)
                                            (if by-row? k fixed))
                                         sc))
                          (if by-row? (range c1 (+ c2 1))
                              (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
       (cond ((not (full c1 #f)) (pour g))
             ((not (full c2 #f)) (flip-lr (pour (flip-lr g))))
             ((not (full r1 #t)) (transpose (pour (transpose g))))
             ((not (full r2 #t))
              (transpose (flip-lr (pour (flip-lr (transpose g))))))
             (else g))))))
